biases.name: Anchoring bias
biases.plain: Letting the first number you see pull your judgement towards it. Like a jacket that "was $300, now $150" feeling cheap, even if it's only worth $80.

biases.name: Availability bias
biases.plain: Judging how likely something is by how easily examples come to mind. Like thinking the beach is dangerous after seeing a shark attack on the news.

biases.name: Confirmation bias
biases.plain: Noticing and remembering what fits what you already believe, and missing what doesn't. Like thinking a teacher dislikes you, and remembering every frown but none of the smiles.

biases.name: Illusory correlation
biases.plain: Seeing a link between two things that isn't really there, because the times they happened together stand out. Like "every time I wash my car, it rains."
